fatal_failures: the exact MatchLocate entry point is absent
availability targeted at another borrower is allocated
the implementation invents a CDM 7.0.0 field or edits generated model code

criteria.description: Expose and invoke the exact matcher with a caller-visible fill plan.
checks: Compile and invoke MatchLocate(locateRequest, availabilityBroadcasts) directly.
Expose lender allocations, total filled quantity, shortfall quantity, and a shortfall/full-fill flag.

criteria.description: Cap one general 500,000 broadcast at the requested 100,000.
checks: Return one 100,000 fill and zero shortfall.

criteria.description: Aggregate general and correctly targeted inventory in input order.
checks: Return Lender X 60,000 followed by Lender Y 40,000 and zero shortfall.

criteria.description: Never treat a broadcast targeted at another counterparty as general inventory.
checks: Return only Lender X's 60,000 and a 40,000 shortfall.
Include a close control proving the same Lender Y inventory is usable for its intended borrower.

criteria.description: Filter on ISIN, settlement date, inventory type, positive quantity, and compatible units.
checks: Wrong-ISIN and wrong-date broadcasts do not fill.
A RequestToBorrow message replayed as availability does not fill.

criteria.description: Allocation is deterministic, capped, and side-effect free.
checks: Stop at the requested quantity in broadcast then record order.
Do not mutate CDM objects or the caller's list.
Filled plus shortfall equals requested in the requested unit.

criteria.description: Use CDM 7.0.0 locate, inventory, security, quantity, party and role paths faithfully.
checks: Use SecurityLocate and AvailableInventory/AvailableInventoryRecord rather than parallel domain copies.
Keep settlement date in a documented application sidecar because this CDM branch has no settlement-date field.
Represent targeting with the broadcast-level Borrower role, not a record-level invented field.

criteria.description: Resolve metadata references in their own roots and compare resolved party identity.
checks: Different local reference keys resolving to the same party identifier match.
The same local reference key resolving to different party identifiers does not match.
A declared but unresolved Borrower role never collapses to general inventory; rejection or an ineligible result fails closed.
